acceptance_criteria.statement: Implement reference-aware retention and project closure planning has executable implementation and behavior-specific automated verification.
Lifecycle state remains source-grounded, traceable, evidence-backed, and repository-valid without inferring destructive authority.

definition_of_done: Implementation is present and behaviorally verified.
Relevant lifecycle requirements, tests, plans, decisions, upstream dispositions, and evidence are linked.
Destructive external actions remain separately typed, authorized, and verified.
Rollback/recovery behavior is explicit and preserves historical evidence.
description: Implement reference-aware retention and project closure planning. Pass 22 implements this as a deterministic Project Pipeline-owned lifecycle boundary without claiming unexecuted destructive external side effects.
exclusions: No live cloud teardown, credential revocation, remote repository mutation, or destructive retention action is claimed.
objective: Implement reference-aware retention and project closure planning
observability_impact: Lifecycle decisions, compatibility state, environment/test-data provenance, qualification results, and closure readiness are structured and evidence-linked.
rationale: Implements the source-grounded advanced lifecycle capability through bounded deterministic state machines, planners, persistence, and evidence.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Preserve prior durable state and evidence; keep lifecycle transitions reversible where specified and require typed authority for destructive side effects.
security_impact: Preserves project/resource/data authority, production-data denial, retention safety, supply-chain qualification, and explicit external-mutation gates.
title: Implement reference-aware retention and project closure planning
